problem_statement: OpenThread should provide a generic array container that holds up to a fixed maximum number of element instances, with the element data stored in a Message. Such a container must support appending entries, reading and overwriting an entry at a given index, looking up a matching entry, and iterating over the entries, returning appropriate error codes for out-of-bounds and capacity conditions. The container and its interface are currently unavailable, so any code that relies on it cannot be built.
